title: Streets of London.wav by theplax
author: theplax
sourceDescription: specifically Charing Cross Road, outside Leicester Square tube station. Saturday evening in the heart of the West End and busy as ever, bit of traffic, few horns, brakes and 'vehicle turning' announcement on a lorry. Whistle at 2:55 is a nice touch. Original file was longer but towards the end a rickshaw drove past blaring out Stayin' Alive so had to cut it down for obvious reasons. Hopefully nobody needed CPR... Pixel 6 internal mics > Voice Record Pro > Adobe Audition.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -13.00 dBFS); 30 ms fades
